title: Triclone Skin Tech Medium Coverage Foundation with Fermented Arnica

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, nonComedogenic, crueltyFree, antioxidants, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, alcoholFree, fragranceFree, peptides, squalane, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Medium Coverage✓ Natural Finish✓ Long-wearing✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Hypoallergenic

What it is: A medium coverage, weightless, non-comedogenic foundation with fermented arnica that helps reduce redness and protects from environmental stress.


Coverage: Medium


Finish: Natural


Formulation: Liquid


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Fermented Arnica: Visibly reduces redness and irritation.

- Intellizen 7 Complex™: proprietary blend of medicinal herbs that promote healing and calming.

- BioFerment 7 Complex™: Proprietary blend of super antioxidants that protect the skin from stress.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Shake well. 

-Blend one to two pumps onto clean, moisturized skin using the Haus Labs Foundation Brush, fingertips, or a beauty sponge.

Ingredients+
- Fermented Arnica: Helps visibly reduces redness and irritation.
- Intellizen 7 Complex™: Proprietary blend of medicinal herbs that promote healing and calming.
- BioFerment 7 Complex™: Proprietary blend of super antioxidants that protect the skin from stress.

Aqua (Water, Eau), Diphenylsiloxy Phenyl Trimethicone, Phenyl Trimethicone, Caprylyl Methicone, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Propylene Glycol Dibenzoate, Isododecane, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Methyl Trimethicone, Lauryl Polyglyceryl-3 Polydimethylsiloxyethyl Dimethicone, C13-15 Alkane, Polyglyceryl-3 Polydimethylsiloxyethyl Dimethicone, Alcohol Denat., Acrylates/Polytrimethylsiloxymethacrylate Copolymer, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Disteardimonium Hectorite, 1,2-Hexanediol, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-10, Arnica Montana Flower Extract**, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Squalane, Pseudozyma Epicola/Camellia Sinensis Seed Oil Ferment Extract Filtrate, Pseudozyma Epicola/Apricot Kernel Oil/Olive Fruit Oil/Sweet Almond Oil/Sunflower Seed Oil/Licorice Root Extract Ferment Extract Filtrate, Pseudozyma Epicola/Apricot Kernel Oil/Olive Fruit Oil/Sunflower Seed Oil/Sweet Almond Oil/(Angelica Gigas/Lithospermum Erythrorhizon) Root, Solanum Lycopersicum (Tomato) Fruit Extract, Dunaliella Salina Extract, Hedychium Coronarium Root Extract, Tocopherol, Althaea Rosea Flower Extract, Taraxacum Officinale (Dandelion) Extract, Perilla Ocymoides Leaf Extract, Panax Notoginseng Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Pseudozyma Epicola/Sunflower Seed Oil Ferment Extract Filtrate, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Magnesium Sulfate, Polypropylsilsesquioxane, Acrylates/Dimethicone Copolymer, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Aluminum Hydroxide, CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), CI 77491/77492/77499 (Iron Oxides).
**Fermented.
